verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 closes the prior major finding. `ALERT_ROUTE_CONSUMERS` is now a complete, independently maintained identity inventory, and the live seam compares it for equality in both directions against the binding-derived consumer map. A whole-`env` deletion from any enrolled consumer therefore produces a named missing identity even though the floor, pairing, canonical-value, and token checks still pass. The hermetic tests exercise that exact non-crashing deletion shape, both drift directions, duplicate identities, parser failures, all supported binding levels, and exact token/repository expressions. The two workflow changes use the estate-canonical repository binding while retaining secret-only token bindings. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
